card.name: The word have after CNS stimulants
card.fires_on: The word "have" right after "CNS stimulants" (or after an inserted "including amphetamine,") in warnings such as "have been associated with". Rarely, a verb like "achieve" after "do not" in dosing text.

modes.label: CNS stimulants have
modes.description: The verb "have" following the subject "CNS stimulants" in warnings on growth suppression or tics.

modes.label: Verb after do not
modes.description: A verb like "achieve" following "do not" in a titration instruction.
modes.example: The dose can be increased to 10 mg/day in patients who do not<< achieve>> optimal control of tics.

card.plain: It fires on the verb "have" in the stock warning that CNS stimulants have been associated with growth slowing or tics.
